entries.said: Annual capex of Rs 12 billion to Rs 16 billion under Project Spring.
entries.quote: in line with our Project Spring guidance of investing ₹ 12 billion - ₹ 16 billion annually through to FY 2030.
entries.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
entries.delivered: Achieved full year FY26 capex of INR 14.8 billion, landing directly inside the targeted INR 12-16 billion range.
entries.evidence: c3 call reported section (Full year capex FY26)

entries.said: Project Spring guidance of 11% to 13% for the long term.
entries.quote: to refer to our Project Spring guidance, we've given a long-term guidance of 11% to 13%.
entries.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
entries.delivered: Reported FY26 EBITDA margin of 14.0%, Q1 FY27 margin of 13.8%, and Q2 FY27 margin of 14.4%.
entries.evidence: Annual financial table (FY26) and Quarterly table (Q1 FY27, Q2 FY27)

entries.said: Aiming for greater than 10% export contribution by FY 2030.
entries.quote: We remain on track toward our greater than 10% export contribution goal.
entries.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
entries.delivered: FY30 target date is ongoing. Specific export contribution percentage is not disclosed in reported financials to evaluate run-rate.
entries.evidence: Call c1 guidance c1.g2 and subsequent calls

entries.said: Progressing towards the 8%-10% FMEG EBITDA target by FY 2030.
entries.quote: progressing towards the 8%-10% EBITDA target by FY 2030.
entries.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
entries.delivered: Target period FY30 is ongoing; quarterly segment EBITDA breakdown for FMEG is not separately reported in tables.
entries.evidence: Call c1 guidance c1.g3 and reported calls

entries.said: BharatNet scheme is expected to generate 4.5 billion over the next 3 years for project execution.
entries.quote: commenced execution of our existing orders under BharatNet scheme, which is expected to generate ₹ 4.5 billion over the next 3 years
entries.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
entries.delivered: Three-year execution timeline spanning through FY29 remains in progress without intermediate revenue contribution reported.

entries.said: The Extra High Voltage (EHV) plant commissioning is expected during FY28.
entries.quote: in terms of our EHV plant timelines, we are expecting the EHV plant to now commission somewhere in FY 2028, the next year, though, so FY28.
entries.speaker: Aditya Nathany
entries.delivered: Target commissioning year FY28 is in the future and cannot yet be tested.

summary: Management's guidance is reliable. Capex targets (INR 14.8B vs INR 12-16B guided) and EBITDA margins (14.0% FY26 vs 12-14% guided) were met. Long-term Project Spring FY30 goals remain open.
business: Polycab manufactures Wires and Cables (W&C), Fast Moving Electrical Goods (FMEG), and executes Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) projects, including Extra High Voltage (EHV) plants and BharatNet execution.
bull: Consolidated revenue grew strongly by 52.8% YoY in Q2 FY27 to Rs 9,899 crore.
EBITDA margins reached 14.4% in Q2 FY27, comfortably achieving the 12% to 14% guidance range.
Net cash balance expanded to Rs 45.2 billion by Q2 FY27, supported by Rs 2,340 crore FY26 free cash flow.
bear: Quarterly EBITDA margins dropped to 12.7% in Q3 FY26 from 15.8% in Q2 FY26, highlighting margin fluctuation.
FMEG EBITDA margin progress toward 8%-10% by FY30 cannot be validated due to missing segment margin data.
Annual capex commitments of Rs 12-16 billion require high capital deployment over the next 5 years.
